name: The Smurfs

tenures.source: The community's own “What ever happened to....:)” thread on rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy, 9–11 August 1995. Read, narrated and deliberately NOT served (it maps personas to real handler names wholesale, the conscription-list class). This join's own lane digest carries the reading.
tenures.note: The thread's opening post lists them under GCW among the names an old-timer might recognise; the reply that stages them names three of them and gives one of the three a match with a result. Their handler is named in the same sentence and is not carried here — a real name, denied under the privacy rule; the record of him is that he was one of the GCW compiler's own circle.

caption: GCW's own Smurfs — the cartoon tag team a 1995 thread remembered first and least fondly of anything the federation ever ran, and the only GCW act anybody wrote a result for.

members.name: Papa
members.note: Named as one of the three and said only to have retired — a mention, not a staging, so no character is minted for him. Almost certainly Papa Smurf, but the document says “Papa” and nothing more, and the registry does not finish the name for it.
